idea-plugin.name: SpringLens - Spring Boot RESTful API Tester
idea-plugin.description:
SpringLens is a lightweight, zero-configuration RESTful API testing client seamlessly integrated into IntelliJ IDEA. Designed specifically for Spring Boot and Spring Cloud developers, it allows you to test, debug, and manage APIs directly within your IDE without switching between external tools.

Key Features

  • Deep AST/PSI Endpoint Scanner: Automatically discovers and indexes all @RestController endpoints across all project modules in real-time.
  • Instant DTO Schema Sync: Generates mock JSON request bodies directly from Java DTO classes, POJOs, and Records with recursive reference protection.
  • Spring Cloud Gateway Support: Automatically resolves Gateway routing rules (StripPrefix, PrefixPath, RewritePath) and microservice context paths.
  • Global Authentication Sharing: Configure Bearer JWT tokens or custom auth headers once and sync them across all endpoints with a single click.
  • Custom Collections & Requests: Create manual requests and custom folders alongside scanned project endpoints for external API testing.
  • Dev-Friendly SSL: Built-in Trust-All SSL handler for local microservices running on self-signed HTTPS certificates.
  • Workspace Persistence: Automatically saves query parameters, headers, and request payloads per project across IDE restarts.
  • Instant cURL Export: Copy formatted cURL commands instantly for terminal execution and team collaboration.

Compatibility

• Spring Framework: 5.x, 6.x
• Spring Boot: 2.x, 3.x
• Spring Cloud: Gateway, Eureka, Consul
• Languages: Java 17+, Kotlin | Build Tools: Maven, Gradle

idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — Initial Stable Release

  • Smart AST Endpoint Scanner: Automatically discovers all Spring Boot REST endpoints across all project modules.
  • DTO Schema Generator: Instant dummy JSON template generation from Java DTO classes with loop detection and smart merge.
  • Spring Cloud Gateway Support: Intelligent URL calculation for microservices routing with StripPrefix, PrefixPath, and context-path retention.
  • Authentication Manager: Bearer Token, Basic Auth, and API Key support with one-click "Apply to All APIs" global synchronization.
  • Postman-Style Native UI: Soft word wrapping, colorful HTTP method badges, response formatting, and cURL export.
  • Trust-All SSL for Dev: Seamless local HTTPS testing without SSLHandshakeException errors.
  • State Persistence: Automatically preserves parameter inputs and testing history across IDE restarts.
